statement:
∀ (B : Finset ℤ) (x : Fin 4 → ℤ → ℝ), (∀ i, KdVPlan.NonnegL2 (x i)) →
(∑ a : Fin 4 → (B.erase 0), if (∑ i : Fin 4, (a i:ℤ))=0
  then (∏ i : Fin 4, x i (a i))/KdVPlan.n3 (a 0) (a 1) (a 2) (a 3) else 0) ≤
(24*4*(3/(1-(Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹))) * ∏ i : Fin 4, KdVPlan.seqN (x i)
proof:
intro B x hx
classical
let B₀ := B.erase 0
let n : ℕ := B₀.sup (fun k => Nat.log 2 k.natAbs)+1
let q : B₀ → Fin n := fun a => ⟨Nat.log 2 (a:ℤ).natAbs, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.le_sup a.property)⟩
have hcount : ∀ l : ℕ, (Finset.univ.filter (fun a : B₀ => (q a:ℕ)=l)).card ≤ 4*2^l := by
  intro l
  let s : Finset B₀ := Finset.univ.filter (fun a => (q a:ℕ)=l)
  have hsub : s.image (fun a : B₀ => (a:ℤ)) ⊆ B₀.filter (fun k => Nat.log 2 k.natAbs=l) := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hk
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨a.property, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2⟩
  have he : (s.image (fun a : B₀ => (a:ℤ))).card = s.card :=
    Finset.card_image_of_injective s Subtype.val_injective
  change s.card ≤ _
  rw [← he]
  exact (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans ((@yui_aux_0020 T gamma R).2 B₀ l)
have hb : ∀ a : B₀, (2:ℝ)^((q a:ℕ)) ≤ |((a:ℤ):ℝ)| ∧ |((a:ℤ):ℝ)| < (2:ℝ)^((q a:ℕ)+1) := by
  intro a
  exact (@yui_aux_0020 T gamma R).1 a (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase a.property)
have h := @yui_aux_0025 T gamma R B₀ (inferInstance) n (fun a => (a:ℤ)) q (fun i a => x i a)
  Subtype.val_injective (fun i a => (hx i).2.1 a) hb hcount
have hnorm : ∀ i : Fin 4, Real.sqrt (∑ a : B₀, (x i a)^2) ≤ KdVPlan.seqN (x i) := by
  intro i
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort]
  exact (hx i).2.2.sum_le_tsum B₀ (fun k hk => sq_nonneg _)
have hprod : (∏ i : Fin 4, Real.sqrt (∑ a : B₀, (x i a)^2)) ≤ ∏ i : Fin 4, KdVPlan.seqN (x i) :=
  Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i hi => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (fun i hi => hnorm i)
have hC : 0 ≤ (24*4*(3/(1-(Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹)) : ℝ) := by
  have hp := (@yui_aux_0022 T gamma R).1.2
  positivity
exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod hC)
